q1.question: How are prices set?
q1.answer: Clients suggest a budget when posting a task. Providers can then make an offer at that price, or suggest a different one. The final price is the one agreed upon between the client and the provider.

q2.question: Is the platform secure?
q2.answer: Yes, security is our priority. We verify providers' identities (KYC), secure all payments through our partner Stripe, and have a rating system to build trust within the community.

q3.question: What happens if there's a problem during a mission?
q3.answer: You can open a dispute directly from the booking detail page. Our support team will then intervene to help you find an amicable solution.

section1.title: Introduction
section1.content: IMU Task (hereinafter 'we' or 'the Platform') is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and protect your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.

section2.title: Data Controller
section2.intro: The data controller for your personal data is:

section4.title: Processing Purposes
section4.intro: We collect and process your personal data for the following purposes:
section4.purpose1_desc: Creation, authentication and management of your user profile
section4.purpose2_desc: Connecting with professionals, message exchange, quote and booking management
section4.purpose3_desc: Validation of professional identity via SIRET number
section4.purpose4_desc: Usage analysis to improve our services
section4.purpose5_desc: Sending notifications related to your account and bookings
section4.purpose6_desc: Fraud prevention and compliance with legal obligations
section4.purpose7_desc: Sending commercial offers (with your prior consent)

section5.title: Legal Basis for Processing
section5.intro: The processing of your data is based on the following legal grounds:
section5.basis4_desc: Retention of billing data, KYB verification

section6.title: Data Recipients
section6.intro: Your personal data may be transmitted to the following recipients:
section6.recipient1_desc: Platform technical and customer support teams
section6.recipient2_desc: As part of a quote request or booking
section6.recipient3_desc: Hosting (Firebase/Google Cloud), payment services, analytics tools

section7.title: Retention Period
section7.intro: We retain your personal data for the following periods:
section7.duration1_desc: For the duration of your account use
section7.duration2_desc: 30 days to allow recovery (then permanent deletion)

section8.title: Your Rights
section8.intro: In accordance with GDPR, you have the following rights:
section8.right1_desc: Obtain a copy of your personal data
section8.right3_desc: Delete your data ('right to be forgotten')
section8.right4_desc: Restrict the processing of your data
section8.right5_desc: Object to the processing of your data (especially marketing)
section8.right6_desc: Receive your data in a structured format
section8.exerciseRights: To exercise your rights, contact us at:
section8.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.

section9.title: Data Security
section9.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction or disclosure:

section10.title: Cookies
section10.intro: The Platform uses cookies to improve your user experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device.
section10.settings: You can configure your browser to refuse cookies, but this may affect Platform functionality.

section11.title: International Transfers
section11.content: Your data is hosted on Google Cloud (Firebase) servers, which may be located outside the European Union. These transfers are governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses and benefit from appropriate safeguards.

section12.title: Policy Changes
section12.content: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be communicated via a notification on the Platform or by email. The date of last update is shown at the top of this document.

q1.question: How are prices set?
q1.answer: Clients propose a budget when posting a task. Providers can then make an offer at this price, or propose a different one. The final price is the one agreed upon by the client and provider.

q2.question: Is the platform secure?
q2.answer: Yes, security is our priority. We verify provider identities (KYC), secure all payments via our Stripe partner, and have a review system to strengthen trust within the community.

q3.question: What happens if there's a problem during a mission?
q3.answer: You can open a dispute directly from the booking details. Our support team will then help you find an amicable solution.
